tidbit: Did you know… about 12,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Goa launches an artificial intelligence policy with school curriculum, labs, and plans for 50k certified professionals by 2030. Confirmed by The Times of India.
SpaceX launches an artificial intelligence partner network with 130 firms, doubling Grok enterprise users to 800K. Confirmed by TradingView.
Ultra Security launches an artificial intelligence agent security platform with 10 million dollars funding and compliance certifications. Reported by Pulse 2.0.
Microsoft's artificial intelligence diagnoses medical cases 4 times more accurately than human doctors, with real-world testing planned. Confirmed by The Verge.
OpenAI nears up to 30 billion dollars funding round at 1.25 trillion valuation led by United Arab Emirates investors. Reported by CNBC.
Free every hour.
